g.text: Each session starts with a bounded working set: the project snapshot, one task record,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and a routed slice of relevant material. Work changes the implementation;

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: task completion admits only durable conclusions back into project memory and archives the task.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: The archive grows, but is not loaded by default.
